detail.subtitle: A plain-language guide, shaped around what you told us.

banner.carrier: This is in your results. You're a carrier, which means you're healthy.
banner.affected: This is in your results. A genetic counsellor will go through what it means for you.
banner.family_history: You're exploring {condition} because it runs in your family. This isn't a diagnosis. Only a genetic test can tell you whether you carry it.
banner.think_i_have: You told us you think you may have this condition. GeneBridge can't diagnose it. A doctor or genetic counsellor can arrange the right test.

couldI.title: Could I be a carrier?
couldI.autosomal_recessive: If a brother or sister has this condition, there is a real chance you carry a changed copy. Only a genetic test can tell you, and it's free and confidential.
couldI.autosomal_dominant: With a dominant condition, one changed copy is enough to have it. If a parent has it, a genetic counsellor can explain what that means for you. Only a genetic test can tell you.
couldI.x_linked: With an X-linked condition, women can carry a changed copy and men are more often affected. If a relative has it, a genetic counsellor can explain what that means for you. Only a genetic test can tell you.
couldI.complex: Inheritance involves several gene copies, so a counsellor explains each family's chances. Only a genetic test can tell you.
